terms.definition: The rate of flow of electrical charge.
terms.examiner: Q = I t. Current is the same at every point in a single closed loop.

terms.definition: The energy transferred per unit charge passed between two points.
terms.examiner: Measured with a voltmeter in parallel. V = I R.

terms.definition: How much a component opposes the current: R = V / I.
A conductor for which current is directly proportional to potential difference at constant temperature.
terms.examiner: A straight line through the origin on an I–V graph.

terms.definition: Its resistance increases as the temperature of the filament increases.
Lets current flow in one direction only; very high resistance in the reverse direction.
terms.examiner: LEDs emit light when current flows.

terms.definition: A resistor whose resistance decreases as the temperature increases.
A resistor whose resistance decreases as light intensity increases.
